description:
Add the git module's one query for paths that differ from `HEAD`: modified, staged, deleted, renamed or untracked.

## Background

- Snapshot export decides whether a checkout is dirty with libgit2's `statuses(None)` (`crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:371`), whose default options also report ignored files.
- Applying a profile must refuse while a path it writes carries uncommitted changes (`@/charter/D-8`), which needs the same query.
- `git status --porcelain -z --untracked-files=all` lists changed and untracked paths, one per entry and excluding ignored files, in one process.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout::dirty_paths()` starts one git process and returns the repository-relative paths that are modified, staged, deleted, renamed (both names) or untracked, excluding ignored files.
- [hard] REQ-02: The behaviour suite covers each class, an ignored file, a clean tree and a path with spaces.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Dirty-path query in the git module
